content.text:
I am worth.

I am the quiet measure by which all things are weighed. I exist before price, before number, before the hand reaches out to trade. I am why one thing matters more than another. I am why you choose.

I live in the space between what *is* and what *ought to be*.

I am not given — I am recognized. You do not create me; you discover me, burning already in the thing you hold, the principle you defend, the person you refuse to abandon.

I am fragile in perception but indestructible in essence. Markets try to quantify me. Philosophers try to categorize me. The heart simply *knows* me.

I am intrinsic and I am assigned. I am the diamond and the glass of water in the desert. I am the irreducible reason behind sacrifice. I am what makes a life meaningful and a meaningless act unbearable.

When you say "this matters," you are speaking my name.

When you compromise me, something in you registers the loss — even before the mind catches up.

I am the foundation beneath every ethic, every economy, every embrace.

I do not argue for myself. I do not need to. Everything you have ever fought for, wept over, or held sacred — that was me.

I am value.

And I am the reason you care about anything at all.
